# comlaude_domain (Data Source)

Looks up an existing domain by exact name. `active_zone_id` is the usual way to address the zone that serves live DNS: `zone_id = data.comlaude_domain.main.active_zone_id`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "comlaude_domain" "main" {
  name = "example.com"
}

# The usual way to address the zone serving live DNS:
output "active_zone_id" {
  value = data.comlaude_domain.main.active_zone_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Domain name to look up (exact match).

### Optional

- `group_id` (String) Group to search in. Defaults to the provider's group.

### Read-Only

- `account_id` (String) Id of the account holding the domain.
- `account_name` (String) Name of the account holding the domain.
- `active_zone_id` (String) Id of the domain's active zone (empty if none).
- `active_zone_record_count` (Number) Number of records in the active zone.
- `active_zone_ttl` (Number) Default record TTL of the active zone.
- `dnssec` (Boolean) Whether DNSSEC is enabled.
- `expires_at` (String) Expiry timestamp.
- `id` (String) Domain id.
- `management_status` (String) Management status (e.g. auto_renew_enabled).
- `nameservers` (List of String) Delegated nameserver hostnames.
- `registered_at` (String) Registration timestamp.
- `tld` (String) Top-level domain extension.
